# Pull Request Template

## Description
Please describe your changes in detail.

## Related Issue
If this PR addresses an open issue, please link it here:
Closes #issue_number

## Type of Change
Please delete options that are not applicable.
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Test addition/update
- [ ] Build/CI changes
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## Checklist
Please ensure your PR meets the following requirements:
- [ ] Code follows the project's spelling conventions (American English internally, British English user-facing)
- [ ] Code has been formatted with `go fmt`
- [ ] Tests have been added or updated for new/changed functionality
- [ ] All tests pass (`go test ./...`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`golangci-lint run ./...`)
- [ ] Security checks pass (`govulncheck ./...`)
- [ ] Documentation has been updated if needed (README, CLI reference, etc.)
- [ ] Changelog entry added (if applicable)

## Screenshots (if applicable)
If your change affects CLI output or behavior, please include screenshots or example terminal sessions.

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem or solution here.
